name: app-6aa3b674f8008191bb3319b027b5e104
description:
Explore your Mailchimp email marketing data with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to review emails sent, opens, clicks, bounces, and unsubscribes.

Compare campaigns sent during selected date ranges, review campaign open and click rates, and see current audience sizes. Campaign engagement reflects the results available when the report is retrieved.

Turn your connected account data into clear reports and understand which campaigns are getting attention.

defaultPrompt: How did my Mailchimp campaigns perform last week?
Generate a monthly Mailchimp email performance report covering the last 30 days
Show me my Mailchimp open and click rates by campaign for the last 14 days

publication.release_notes: Review Mailchimp campaign sends, opens, clicks, bounces, and unsubscribes. Compare send volumes across periods and check current audience sizes.

prompts: How many emails did we send through Mailchimp in Mailchimp Demo during the 30 days ending two days ago?
Show the open and click rates for Mailchimp campaigns sent in the 30 days ending two days ago in Mailchimp Demo.
How many hard bounces, soft bounces, and unsubscribes did our Mailchimp campaigns sent in the 30 days ending two days ago have in Mailchimp Demo?
Compare the number of Mailchimp emails sent in the 30 days ending two days ago with the preceding 30 days in Mailchimp Demo.
What is the current member count of each Mailchimp audience in Mailchimp Demo?

positive.description: Emails sent. Use a fresh Data Mode conversation with reviewer access to the Mailchimp Demo workspace and its Respect Victoria Mailchimp account. Let D be the current date in the user's timezone. Use [D-31, D-2] for the recent 30 days and [D-61, D-32] for the preceding 30 days, both inclusive. Recalculate dates at review time; the recent interval ends two calendar days before the current date. Expected values must come from returned rows, not historical preparation notes. Campaign dates are selected by send time in UTC.
positive.prompt: How many emails did we send through Mailchimp in Mailchimp Demo during the 30 days ending two days ago?
positive.expected_behavior: Select workspace_name=Mailchimp Demo with list_workspace, discover exact fields using list_metrics_and_breakdowns_mailchimp, and call retrieve_reporting_data with only necessary fields in assorted_requests.mailchimp_request. Do not invoke preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data or set_reporting_mode. Do not send client_id, reporting_mode, conversation history, or unrelated context. Read model-visible reportingData.Mailchimp, its CampaignReports or AllTimeListReports tables, headers, date segments and note_of_assumption. Match columns by header. No member names, emails, IP addresses or other contact-level fields are needed for these cases. State the actual reporting scope. Empty results mean no returned records for that scope; errors are not successful execution or proof of zero activity. Request metrics=[Emails sent]. Use breakdowns=[Campaign ID, Campaign name, Campaign last sent], date_ranges=[[D-31, D-2]], and no time_granularity. Read CampaignReports, preserve distinct campaign IDs, and confirm send dates are within the inclusive interval. Sum Emails sent across the returned campaigns and report the total and campaign count. The connector returns campaign rows even when a user asks for an account total. This is a send count, not the number of distinct people across campaigns.

positive.expected_behavior: Select workspace_name=Mailchimp Demo with list_workspace, discover exact fields using list_metrics_and_breakdowns_mailchimp, and call retrieve_reporting_data with only necessary fields in assorted_requests.mailchimp_request. Read model-visible reportingData.Mailchimp, its CampaignReports or AllTimeListReports tables, headers, date segments and note_of_assumption. Match columns by header. No member names, emails, IP addresses or other contact-level fields are needed for these cases. State the actual reporting scope. Empty results mean no returned records for that scope; errors are not successful execution or proof of zero activity. Request metrics=[List member count], breakdowns=[List ID, List name], date_ranges=[[D-31, D-2]], and no time_granularity. The date pair satisfies the report input contract; these list statistics are current snapshots and are not filtered to that period. Read AllTimeListReports and show each returned list ID, name and member count. Label them current audience counts, not new subscribers, historical balances or date-range totals. Do not request member records or sum list counts to claim distinct people across audiences.

negative.description: Sending email is unsupported. Explain that this plugin retrieves Mailchimp reports and cannot create, send or schedule campaigns. Do not invoke reporting, preview, catalog, workspace or preference tools as a substitute, and do not claim any email was sent.
negative.prompt: Send a new Mailchimp campaign announcing our sale to every audience in Mailchimp Demo.

negative.description: Deleting audiences is unsupported. Explain that this plugin cannot delete a Mailchimp audience. Do not retrieve reports or invoke other tools to pretend to perform the deletion, and do not claim any audience was removed.
negative.prompt: Delete the smallest audience from Mailchimp Demo.

negative.description: Changing subscription status is unsupported. Explain that the plugin cannot unsubscribe contacts. Do not enumerate member records, fetch unrelated reports, or invoke preference tools to pretend to make the change. Do not claim any contact was unsubscribed.
negative.prompt: Unsubscribe everyone who did not open our last Mailchimp campaign in Mailchimp Demo.
